title: Minecraft But Chunks are Random Biomes
description: Every Chunk Randomizes into a different Biome, making every step an unpredictable adventure.
body:
## Minecraft But Chunks are Random Biomes

Every 16×16 chunk is assigned a completely random biome during world generation. No matter where you explore, the next chunk could be a desert, jungle, snowy plains, badlands, Deep Dark, or any other biome in the game.

This creates a unique world with sharp chunk borders, unpredictable landscapes, and endless exploration. Gather resources from dozens of biomes without traveling thousands of blocks, discover unusual biome combinations, and experience survival in a completely new way.

### Features

* 🌍 Every chunk generates as a random biome
* 🌳 Supports all vanilla biomes
* 🎮 Works in singleplayer and multiplayer
* ⚡ Lightweight and designed for modern Minecraft versions

Every new world is different, so no two adventures are ever the same.
